lines.text: Write to ask, not for ask!
Many learners say: I am writing for ask about the class.
Better: I am writing to ask about the class.
Say to ask, not for ask.
The second! I am writing to ask about the class.

data.wrong: I am writing for ask about the class.
data.right: I am writing to ask about the class.
data.why: Say to ask, not for ask.

native.tip: نقول «أكتب لأسأل»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول to ask: “I am writing to ask about the class.” وليس “I am writing for ask about the class.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I am writing for ask about the class.” 😅 في العربية نقول «أكتب لأسأل» بحرف «لـ»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول to ask، فالجملة الصحيحة “I am writing to ask about the class.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “to ask” — نقول I am writing to ask في الرسائل. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «أكتب لأسأل» with the letter «لـ», but in English we say to ask: “I am writing to ask about the class.” not “I am writing for ask about the class.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I am writing for ask about the class.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أكتب لأسأل» with the letter «لـ», but in English we say to ask, so the right sentence is “I am writing to ask about the class.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
